metadata.description: Data engineering agent that creates, extends, and explores dlt data pipelines

plugins.name: rest-api-pipeline
plugins.description: Build dlt pipelines for REST APIs: find a source, scaffold the pipeline, add endpoints and incremental loading, debug it, validate the data and view it in a report. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: bootstrap
plugins.description: Start here. Sets up uv, dlt[hub] and the dlthub workspace, then installs the dltHub toolkit for your task with the dlthub CLI.

plugins.name: data-exploration
plugins.description: Get quick insights from a dlt pipeline: profile its tables, plan charts and assemble a marimo dashboard. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: dlthub-platform
plugins.description: Prepare and deploy your dlthub workspace and pipelines to the dltHub platform, and debug failed deployments. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: init
plugins.description: Shared rules, secrets handling, background agent authoring and the workspace MCP server used by the other dlthub toolkits. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: transformations
plugins.description: Turn raw dlt pipeline data into a Canonical Data Model: annotate sources, build an ontology, design a Kimball-style model and write @dlt.hub.transformation functions. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: sql-database-pipeline
plugins.description: Load tables from any SQLAlchemy-supported database into a destination with dlt, and tune performance with the available backends. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: data-quality
plugins.description: Add column-level checks and load metrics to dlt pipelines, run them on every load and review failures with diagnosis. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: filesystem-pipeline
plugins.description: Load CSV, Parquet, JSONL or custom files from local disk, S3, GCS, Azure or SFTP into a destination with dlt. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: quick-start
plugins.description: A guided path from ingestion to visualization, transformation and deployment in 3-5 prompts. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: one-shot
plugins.description: Build a minimal GitHub issues pipeline and deploy it to the dltHub platform in one go. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: dlthub-init-skills
plugins.description: Build and deploy a minimal custom REST API pipeline to the dltHub platform after running uvx dlthub-init. Requires dlt[hub].

plugins.name: performance
plugins.description: Find the slow stage of a dlt pipeline (extract, normalize or load) and tune parallelism, workers, buffers, file rotation and batching. Requires dlt[hub].
